issue_request: FHIR-8352 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 QICore ballot item asking that a ValueSet copyright statement present in XML, specifically for a SNOMED CT-based value set, also appear on the generated ValueSet HTML page. The Jira description identified this as a core FHIR publishing tools issue, and the only Jira comment said it looked already fixed.
initial_application: No current FHIR git commit mentioning FHIR-8352 was found. Historical DSTU2-era publisher code in the old fhir-crucible/fhir_dstu2 source renders ValueSet copyright in both summary and narrative paths, corroborating the Jira comment that the original publishing-tools fix had already happened outside any current spec-source edit.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current source model defines ValueSet.copyright plus later ValueSet.compose.include.copyright support. A current source example such as source/valueset/valueset-designation-use.xml carries SNOMED CT copyright metadata; the fetched CI HTML page did not visibly render it. The Java renderer that would control that behavior now lives in external publisher code, not in this FHIR spec checkout, and current external org.hl7.fhir.core ValueSetRenderer source contains ValueSet copyright rendering calls.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. A core-source workaround such as duplicating copyright text in individual ValueSet narratives or adding unsupported template placeholders would not safely fix the generic generated-HTML behavior requested by the issue.
